purpose: Teach: 同性愛/囚人/開戦/捕虜/硬化/反逆/窮地/救援

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、同性愛患者様の医療差別防止を医療チームで徹底します
lines.en: Ren, our medical team is rigorous about preventing discrimination against our gay patients.
lines.style: Calm clinical steadiness with deliberate warmth; unhurried, each word intentional, meeting his eyes.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、囚人医療の倫理を医療チームで尊重します
lines.en: Ren, we respect the ethics of prison medicine on this team as well.
lines.style: Level, principled delivery; slight firming on 'ethics', no rise in volume, quietly certain.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦時下の医療対応、つまり開戦時の医療史を医療チームで学びます
lines.en: Ren, we study wartime medical response — the history of medicine at the outbreak of war.
lines.style: Measured, reflective pacing; a thoughtful pause at the clarification, voice softening on the history.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、捕虜のメンタルケアを医療チームで研究します
lines.en: Ren, our team also researches mental health care for prisoners of war.
lines.style: Gentler, slower tone reserved for hard subjects; steady and unflinching, care audible underneath.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、動脈硬化の早期発見を医療チームで進めます
lines.en: Ren, we're pushing forward on early detection of arteriosclerosis as a team.
lines.style: Brisker, energized clinical pace; a small lift of purpose on 'early detection', forward-leaning.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、診療への反逆的態度の患者様にも医療チームで丁寧に対応します
lines.en: Ren, even with patients who resist treatment, our team responds with patience and care.
lines.style: Soft, even delivery with no judgment in it; slowing kindly on 'patience and care'.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者様の窮地に医療チームで寄り添います
lines.en: Ren, when a patient is in dire straits, our whole team stays right beside them.
lines.style: Warmth finally surfacing through the clinical calm; quieter, slower, almost a promise.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、災害救援医療チームを医療チームで派遣します
lines.en: And Ren — we dispatch a disaster relief medical team from our own staff.
lines.style: Settled, quietly proud close; unhurried final line, a faint smile audible on the last words.
